{{Quote|People of Onderon, the time has come to take back our freedom. We have all been deceived. King Rash is a traitor who has sold Onderon to the Separatists for the crown. But Onderon is ours.|Steela Gerrera|<ref name="The Soft War" />}}
'''Onderon''' was a [[jungle]] [[Planet|world]] located within the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the planetary government seceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; in the [[Separatist Senate]], Onderon was represented by [[Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri]] and later by her son, [[Lux Bonteri]]. In response to this [[Politics|political]] posture, a [[Onderon rebels|rebel]] cell on Onderon, led by siblings [[Steela Gerrera|Steela]] and [[Saw Gerrera]], formed with aid from the [[Jedi Order|Jedi]]. This band of rebels excised the Separatist occupation from the planet, opening the door to joining the [[Galactic Republic]]. When [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] transformed the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] and declared himself [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], the planet was taken over by the Imperials. This led to the formation of the [[Partisans]] led solely by Saw Gerrera.

==Description==
{{Quote|I was younger than you are now. I was a prisoner. They made a work camp in the jungle. No droids, no beasts, just men and cargo. Onderon jungle. Real jungle. Hot, wet, blistering jungle.|Saw Gerrera|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref>}}
Onderon was a temperate jungle planet.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
===Rise===
In its earliest ages of civilization, Onderon was a [[Planet|world]] marked with savage [[jungle]]s that were filled with dangerous creatures. To survive, the primitive [[human]] inhabitants of the planet protected themselves behind the walls of fortified settlements. Over [[time]], these settlements grew to become enormous walled [[City|cities]], including the planet's [[capital]], [[Iziz]].<ref name="Onderon Databank" /> A grouping of [[Onderonian outcasts|societal outcasts]] ended up living within Onderon's jungles instead of the protected cities. Within those jungles, they used the [[ruping]]s as mounts.<ref name="Ruping DB">{{Databank|ruping|Ruping}}</ref>

According to the quasi-historical [[Qel-Droma Epics]], a [[Sith]] [[Translation Talisman]] allowed its wearer to instantly understand [[the Force]]-imbued writings of [[Sith scroll]]s and [[Sith spellbook|spellbooks]]. [[Krath]] leader [[Satal Keto]] found one on Onderon and reproduced it to train his fellow Krath. It was considered one of the most prized relics sought by Qel-Droma Epics [[scholar]]s.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> Onderon would join the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Tipping Points" /> but also had a history of neutrality.<ref name="Dawn Rebels">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Separatists_on_Onderon.png|thumb|left|200px|Separatist forces were present on Onderon during the Clone Wars.]]
In the [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Politics|political]] idealist [[Count]] [[Dooku]] spread political turmoil on the world along with a host of others across [[the galaxy]] such as [[Sullust]].<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> During the time of the [[Clone Wars]], the Inner Rim was of strategic interest to the Confederacy,<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> so the Separatist-backed [[Monarch of Onderon|monarch]] [[King]] [[Sanjay Rash]] allied Onderon with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Onderon Databank" /> after pro-Separatist coup<ref name="TCW Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}}</ref> and [[Invasion of Onderon|Separatist invasion]] deposed [[Monarchy|monarch]] [[Ramsis Dendup]].<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> However, many [[Onderonian]]s refused to recognize the legitimacy of Rash's rule, as they preferred the neutral stance championed by Dendup. This opposition led to the formation of the [[Onderon rebels]], a group of freedom-fighters trained by [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight|Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Onderon Databank" />

Led by Skywalker, a contingent from the Republic, including [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Clone Captain|Captain]] [[Rex]], helped secretly train and arm the rebels to [[Onderonian Civil War|fight]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. Forced to [[Saw Gerrera's camp|hide]] out in the jungles of Onderon, the rebels trained to learn how to take down [[droid]]s and [[tank]]s with the help of [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade|EMP grenades]]. However, in the midst of the training the training camp was attacked by a droid [[battalion]]. The rebels, with the help of the Jedi, were able to defeat the droids with relative ease. Now battle-tested, the rebels felt ready to infiltrate Iziz.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>

Within Iziz, the rebels continued fighting against droids, covertly and systematically destroying droid patrols and checkpoints. Thinking these actions were led by the deposed Dendup, Rash ordered the former king to stop the attacks. It soon became known that Dendup was not in charge of the rebel attacks, frustrating Rash.<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref>

Continuing the siege, the rebels were able to take out the droids' [[Onderon power generator|main power supply]] by hijacking one of the droid [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|battle tanks]], knocking out the power grid after a skirmish. These actions were brought to the attention of Dooku, who was displeased with Rash for not being able to quell the insurgents. Rash blamed the droids for this and asked for reinforcements. In response, the Count sent [[General]] [[Kalani]], a [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]], to win where Rash had failed. With the power supply down, the rebels were able to take down more and more droids quite easily with little resistance. Some time later the leader of the resistance, [[Steela Gerrera]], was able to send a message to the people of Iziz that their true king, Dendup, was silenced by Rash and that they would take back their city.<ref name="Front Runners" />

This message concerned Rash, so he ordered the [[Death|execution]] of the former king. This news made its way back to the insurgency. Steela's brother, [[Saw Gerrera]], decided to rescue the former king without help but was captured by the droids. He was then brought inside the palace for interrogation overseen by Kalani and [[Royal Onderon Militia|General]]<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref> [[Akenathen Tandin]].<ref name="TCW CE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref> Kalani intended to [[torture]] Saw to death but was stopped short by Tandin, who believed the droid's tactics ineffective against stopping the rebels. However, the droid believed that Tandin merely pitied Gerrera. Saw and the general spoke with each other, the general explaining how Gerrera was viewed as a [[terrorist]], and how Tandin chose to stay free by going under the Separatists' rule. Saw viewed himself not as a terrorist, but as a freedom fighter trying to free his people from Separatist occupation.

At the public execution of Dendup, the rebels attempted to free the king, but they were apprehended by droid reinforcements. Tandin, a witness to the rebels' capture, gathered the royal guard and freed the [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] rebels. The resistance fighters were able to escape while the general held Rash as hostage. The general himself was held at gunpoint, so Tano jumped out of the crowd watching the execution and [[Force push]]ed the droids away, stunning them. The two were able to escape from the droids with the people stopping the droids going after them. Now that the Dendup was freed, the people were more rebellious against the droids and Rash's rule.<ref name="The Soft War" />

The rebels made their way to distant [[Onderon highlands|mountains]], where they established a [[The nest|base of operations]]. Back in the city, [[Lux Bonteri]] and Tano showed the insurgency's last message, now by Dendup. This message finally instigated mass action across the capital, causing riots and chaos in the city. Meanwhile droid [[scout]]s were able to locate the rebels' hideout in the eastern [[mountain]]s. As Rash seemed helpless, Kalani assured him that with the death of both Dendup and the rebellion, fear would bring order back to the people. He also sent additional reinforcements to assist the droid [[army]] in the form of [[HMP droid gunship]]s.<ref name="Tipping Points" />

As the droid army made their way to the mountains, the rebels at first were able to eliminate most of the droids very easily, but as the gunships arrived, the rebels were outgunned and outmatched very quickly. The battle seemed to lost and Tano was ordered to retreat back to [[Coruscant]] by Kenobi, reasoning sometimes people need to fight their own battles. Back on Coruscant, Skywalker did not accept the fact that the Republic should just ignore helping the rebels, so he traveled to [[Florrum]] to make a deal with [[Hondo Ohnaka]], hiring him to illegally deliver [[Missile launcher|rocket launchers]] to the rebels on Onderon.<ref name="Tipping Points" />

[[File:Fambaa.png|thumb|right|200px|Fambaas were native to both Onderon and Naboo.]]
During the battle, the rebels were dealing with heavy casualties from the new [[gunship]]s, but the fight took a new turn when Ohnaka and a couple of [[Ohnaka Gang|his]] [[pirate]]s brought them the rocket launchers Skywalker ordered. The rebels were able to take down the gunships with the help of the new weapons. Back in the base, [[BX-series droid commando|commando droids]] discovered the King's hideout and almost killed him, but they were destroyed by Steela in time. At the same time, Saw and the rebels blew up the remaining two gunships, one of which crashed at the side of the mountain the King was on. As a result of the crash, the mountain broke down, leaving Steela hanging on the edge. Bonteri came to help but was knocked down as well. Bonteri was rescued by Tano. With Bonteri safe, Tano focused her attention on Steela, and [[Telekinesis|levitated]] Steela from the edge of the cliff. However, the crashed droid gunship was still marginally operational however and shot a blast at Tano's shoulder, interrupting her [[The Force|Force]] grip on Steela who dropped and fell to her death.<ref name="Tipping Points" />

With Steela's sacrifice, the rebels rallied to defeat the droid army once and for all. Back in the city Rash was desperate, demanding more reinforcements from Dooku. Dooku however was not pleased with his lack of control, and he ordered Kalani to regroup the remaining forces and bring them back to [[Agamar]]. The droid general executed Rash as a result of his failure, and retreated from Onderon.<ref name="Tipping Points" />

With the Separatist army gone, Onderon was finally freed and joined the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Tipping Points" /> However, Onderon was under [[Siege at Onderon|siege]], prior to the [[Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="OFNF">{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}}</ref>

===Age of the Empire===
The peace bought through sacrifice during the Clone Wars was not long-lasting. The Republic [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformed]] into the first [[Galactic Empire]] and it [[Annexation of Onderon|annexed]] Onderon.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> Saw Gerrera was considered for the role of Imperial [[governor]].<ref name="Mask of Fear">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref> However, among the immediate demands of the Empire was full disarmament, and in response to these demands and Imperial rule more broadly, an [[Onderon insurgency|insurgency]] rose up, led once again by Saw Gerrera.<ref name="Mask of Fear" /><ref name="Ultimate New">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref>

Shortly after [[Order 66]], Imperial Admiral and [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Tarkin]] tested the loyalty of [[Clone Force 99]], also known as the "Bad Batch," on a [[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|mission to Onderon]]. Tarkin told the elite clones that they needed to eliminate a band of "Separatist insurgents" on Onderon. However, when the squad arrived, they came upon a group of people, former Republic fighters and refugees that included children and elderly individuals. The Bad Batch's leader, [[Hunter]], disobeyed orders by refusing to fire upon refugees and families. The group, led by Saw Gerrera, surrounded the Bad Batch and captured them. Gerrera made an offer for the clones to join his resistance group, but the Bad Batch chose instead to return to [[Kamino]].<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref> Ultimately, however, Gerrera declared the planet to be a lost cause and retreated from it.<ref name="Ultimate New" />

Later, a new [[Elite Squad|squad]] led by [[Crosshair]], who had left the Clone Force 99 due to their defection from the Empire, arrived to [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|finish the mission]] to eliminate Saw and his militia. However, Saw was already gone, and the only ones left were some militia members and some civilians. All were killed, including the [[Elite Squad Trooper]] [[ES-01]], who had refused to eliminate the civilians, which was seen as treason by Crosshair.<ref name="Replacements">{{TBB|Replacements}}</ref>

Around [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]] and his first<ref name="Rebels" /> [[stormtrooper]] [[Alexsandr Kallus' squad|squad]]<ref name="Comp Ency">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> were deployed to Onderon to assist in bringing Imperial peace and security to the troubled world. Kallus and his unit were then [[Attack on an Imperial patrol|ambushed]] by a [[Lasat]] [[Unidentified Lasat mercenary|mercenary]] who worked for Saw, and Kallus and his unit were caught in an explosion. Kallus was knocked out of the way and the [[mercenary]] slowly walked through the smoke and fire and killed every Imperial except for Kallus, including the ones injured in the blast and unable to defend themselves.<ref name="Rebels" />

In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Outlaws Date">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> a [[shuttle]] bound for Onderon departed from [[transport bay three]] from [[Kijimi Spaceport]] on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet [[Kijimi]].<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>

===Late Empire, New Republic Era===
During the [[Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref> in [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Main story date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the main events of ''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]'' to [[4 ABY]].</ref> after the demise of Emperor Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor]] and formation of the [[New Republic]], [[Grand Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]] authorized a [[strike at Onderon]]—as well as a [[strike at Gorse|strike]] on the planet [[Gorse]] and the [[scouring of Mon Cala]]—to lure the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] away from the [[Nadiri Dockyards]], hoping to clear the path for an [[Attack at Nadiri Dockyards|Imperial attack]] on [[Project Starhawk]]. By targeting Onderon and Gorse, Sloane also hoped to disrupt the New Republic's supply lines.<ref name="Squadrons" />
